NONE: › to touch, rub, or press something or someone gently and/or in a way that shows your love, especially with the head or nose, usually with small repeated movements
（尤指用頭或鼻）輕觸，輕擦，磨擦

example: My dog came and nuzzled my foot to try and cheer me up.
我的狗過來用鼻子輕輕擦我的腳，想令我高興起來。
The kittens like to nuzzle up against/up to their mother.
小貓喜歡緊緊挨著牠們的媽媽。
